name: Blueprint Cutaway
why: A cylinder cross-section drawn as an engineer's blueprint shows all four strokes in one picture that keeps moving.
look: Deep navy drafting sheet with a faint grid, white line art, a cool-blue air-fuel cloud turning orange-hot; one orange accent for whatever the voice names. Rubik type.
motion: Mechanical: the piston and crank turn continuously; labels snap in on their word; hard cuts between shots.
